record.question: Choose the right preposition or prepositional phrase to fill in the blank: His health broke down suddenly __________ overwork.
record.explanation: Answer A: on account of. “On account of” introduces the stated cause, overwork. “In regard to” concerns a topic; “in spite of” expresses concession rather than cause. Original paper prints three choices; the empty imported fourth slot was removed after visual source inspection. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no examiner key is asserted.
